bays.road: Zone N (Homerton and Lower Clapton) — Homerton Hospital area
bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit holders, visitor vouchers or paid short-stay parking in marked bays
bays.times: Mon-Fri 7.30am-6.30pm
bays.tariff: Around Homerton Hospital this part of Zone N is Hackney tariff Band 4 — per hour: zero-emissions vehicles £1.95; petrol registered from 2005 £2.50; diesel registered from 2015 £3.65; all other vehicles £4.65. The rest of Zone N is Band 3
bays.pay: RingGo (app or website) or cash at a PayPoint shop — text 'Shop' plus the location number to 81025 for the nearest PayPoint; most of Hackney has no pay-and-display machines. One-hour minimum rate at all locations

bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — permit holders, visitor vouchers or paid short-stay parking in marked bays
bays.times: Mon-Fri 7.30am-6.30pm. Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park event days: Monday to Friday 7.30am to 8.30pm; weekends and bank holidays midday to 6pm
bays.tariff: Hackney short-stay tariff Band 3 — per hour: zero-emissions vehicles £2.70; petrol registered from 2005 £3.85; diesel registered from 2015 £4.90; all other vehicles and pay-and-display machines £5.90
bays.pay: RingGo (app or website) or cash at a PayPoint shop — text 'Shop' plus the location number to 81025 for the nearest PayPoint; most of Hackney has no pay-and-display machines. One-hour minimum rate at all locations

bays.restriction: council car park (paid)
bays.times: Charged 8am to 5pm daily. Gate closing times vary by season (8am to 5.30pm in winter, to 8pm May to August) — you must leave before the gates close
bays.tariff: Weekdays 8am to 5pm — per hour: zero-emissions vehicles £2.70; petrol registered from 2005 £3.85; diesel registered from 2015 £4.90; all other vehicles and pay-and-display payments £5.90. Weekends 8am to 5pm — per hour: zero-emissions vehicles £1.35; petrol registered from 2005 £1.95; diesel registered from 2015 £2.45; all other vehicles and pay-and-display payments £2.95
bays.pay: RingGo (app or website) or pay-and-display machine where fitted
